# Noa legal

The privacy policy and terms of service for the Noa iOS app, served over GitHub
Pages.

**Do not edit the HTML here.** It is generated. The source of truth is
`App/Resources/Legal/*.md` in the app repo, which is the same Markdown the app
bundles and renders in Settings, so a hand edit here makes the hosted policy and
the in-app policy disagree.

To update, from the app repo:

```bash
python3 Tools/release/legal-site.py --out build/noa-legal
```

then copy the output over this repo and push.
